definitions.explanation: The process of making operations, processes, or systems more efficient and productive.

examples.japanese: {業務|ぎょうむ}の{効率化|こうりつか}を{進|すす}める。
examples.english: We are promoting the streamlining of operations.

examples.japanese: IT{導入|どうにゅう}で{仕事|しごと}が{効率化|こうりつか}された。
examples.english: Work was streamlined through IT implementation.

examples.japanese: コスト{削減|さくげん}と{効率化|こうりつか}が{課題|かだい}だ。
examples.english: Cost reduction and efficiency improvement are challenges.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{効率|こうりつ} (efficiency) + {化|か} (-ization)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {効率化|こうりつか}を{図|はか}る - to promote efficiency
- {効率化|こうりつか}を{進|すす}める - to advance streamlining
- {効率化|こうりつか}が{求|もと}められる - efficiency is required

BUSINESS CONTEXTS:
- {生産|せいさん}の{効率化|こうりつか} - production efficiency
- {物流|ぶつりゅう}の{効率化|こうりつか} - logistics streamlining
- {事務|じむ}の{効率化|こうりつか} - office work efficiency

RELATED -{化|か} WORDS:
- {自動化|じどうか} - automation
- {最適化|さいてきか} - optimization
- {合理化|ごうりか} - rationalization
